content.title: Laminated Pastry Chain | Enclosure, Folding, Baking and Interior Proof
content.summary: Rye herb rolls move through butter enclosure, lamination, six-piece shaping, baking and one interior proof. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult chef, one workspace, one ingredient set, one cutting tool, one heated vessel, one plate and one adult diner remain bound. + Each beat performs one irreversible food-state operation and preserves visible material traces from the prior state. + Prepared ingredients enter the same heated vessel and cannot reset to whole raw form after cooking begins. + The plated food carried through the route is the same cooked batch proven in the wok. + The final adult tasting reaction occurs only after handoff and keeps the remaining dish visible as completion evidence.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult baker's hands, a cool marble bench, one rye dough rectangle, a green herb-butter slab, a maple rolling pin and one dark tray. Roll the same laminated slab once more, cut exactly six triangles and curl each triangle into one spiral on the same tray. Break one roll above the tray to prove green herb layers and steam, then return both halves beside the other five without introducing a different batch.
required_anchors: One adult hand identity, one work surface, one dough, one fat layer, one rolling tool and one tray persist.
Each beat performs one irreversible food-state operation and inherits visible material traces from the prior state.
The oven transition returns the same tray and positions with a plausible baked-state change.
The terminal split uses one item from the verified batch and exposes internal layers without substitution.
